Office Kit PowerPoint browser renderer

@office-kit/pptx 0.28.0 and @office-kit/pptx-preview 0.21.0
Source: https://github.com/office-kit/pptx
Includes fflate 0.8.3: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
All three are MIT licensed. Package integrity is recorded in tools/pptx-preview/package-lock.json.
The app uses the browser SVG entry. The Node rasterizer and font files are not bundled.

Rebuild from tools/pptx-preview with Node/npm and Bun 1.4.3:
  npm ci --ignore-scripts --omit=optional
  bun build entry.js --target=browser --format=esm --minify \
    --outfile=../../assets/js/vendor/office-kit-pptx-0.21.0.mjs

Office Kit license (same in both packages)
